prompts.background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the approved Chanko UI reference. Produce ONLY the Living Room BACKGROUND plate from the upper hero scene as a clean wide landscape raster around 2.5:1. Faithfully preserve warm Candy Pop soft 3D room, peach/lavender walls, shelf and small plant far left, arched sunny window and greenery at right, peach wooden tabletop across bottom, matching frontal slightly elevated camera and soft lighting. REMOVE the cat, cushion, hourglass/books foreground stack, calendar, wallet, heart jar, speech bubble, reaction marks and all text. Fill behind removed objects naturally with the same empty room and tabletop. Leave center and lower foreground empty to receive separate transparent props. No UI/header/cards/navigation. No text, no border, no baked rounded corners. This is a background layer for the exact reference, not a redesigned room.
prompts.cat: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready isolated game sprite matching the white kitten in the living-room of the attached UI reference, NOT a scene. White kitten lying chin on two paws on a lavender oval tufted cushion, left eye glossy black open, right eye wink, peach inner ears, tiny smile and whiskers. Same soft 3D Candy Pop style. SINGLE CAT PLUS CUSHION ONLY. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Clean cutout alpha silhouette: zero outer glow, zero bloom, zero fog, zero vignette, zero cast shadow, zero ground plane, zero atmospheric lighting, zero ambient halo, zero gradient around subject. Entire background outside the physical cat/cushion is alpha 0. Cat and cushion opaque. Fully visible with 8% empty transparent padding all sides, square composition. No text, no room, no additional objects.
